title: SEC6: MutexGuard !Send enforces lock-before-await discipline
description: outbox_tick documents that the store lock must be dropped before any .await. Rather than relying on developer attention, the architecture comment notes that this is enforced by the borrow checker: MutexGuard<Store> is !Send, so holding one across an .await point is a compile error in async contexts. The code is structured in explicit drop scopes (brace blocks and explicit drop() calls) to make the invariant visible, but the compiler catches accidental violations. This is a meaningful safety property, not just documentation.
